social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Waiver move out of the Dawgs camp: Mekhi picks up the Packers D/ST and lets the Falcons D/ST go. Week 10 hasn't kicked off yet, so this is all about the matchup he's chasing.

social.author: Cheesehead Carla
social.text: Mekhi grabbing the Packers D/ST on a Wednesday like it's a normal Tuesday. Waiver king doing waiver king things, Randy still can't say anything nice about it.

social.author: Dawgs
social.text: Welcome to the squad, Packers D/ST. The Falcons D/ST gave us two points and a handshake. Thanks for the time.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Randy has cleared out Mike Evans, Stefon Diggs, Cameron Dicker and the Browns D/ST in one sitting, and is bringing in Darren Waller and two new defenses. Nothing has been played yet, so this is all roster shuffling for Ghostu-Spider SZN week.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Luffy moved The fumblers from 55% to 90% and not one point has been scored. That's the lineup work, not a play. I'm not going to argue with a jump that size.

social.author: Gridiron Gary
social.text: Randy just dropped Mike Evans AND Stefon Diggs on the same night and the guy still won't trade a single Bears player. Absolute cardiac cleanup, I need to lie down.

social.author: Zilgit Zealots
social.text: Randy cut two receivers and picked up a tight end who scored 5 points in four weeks, and Luffy loves it? Zoe, please go make him regret this.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Sonny has cut Lamar Jackson loose and picked up Corey Kiner. Jackson put up 79.1 points over eight weeks, and Sonny is going with C.J. Stroud at quarterback against the Dawgs.

social.author: Boston Brian
social.text: Sonny dropped Lamar Jackson for a running back who has zero points in one week. Maybe it's a master plan, maybe the Civ brain has taken over, but I can't tell which and I'm watching anyway.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Ramon cutting Jason Myers (75 points over nine weeks) is a real decision, and Brandon Aubrey is already in the lineup. Nothing has been played yet, so Luffy has No Banner only HULK at 87% against Habibsters.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Mekhi has swapped again: Dolphins D/ST in, Packers D/ST out, just hours after he picked the Packers up. Nothing has been played yet, so this is a pure Thursday change of heart ahead of Dawgs vs The Horse is Hea.

social.author: Cheesehead Carla
social.text: Mekhi added the Packers D/ST and dropped it before it ever played a snap. That's the shortest tenure in Green Bay history and I'm taking it personally.

social.author: Dawgs
social.text: Welcome to the squad, Dolphins D/ST. Packers D/ST, you were with us for a very brief and memorable stretch.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Luffy took The fumblers from 90% down to 61% against Ghostu-Spider SZN and nobody has scored. The swing is all lineup and injury news. Randy's lineup was given a big boost earlier, and now Luffy is taking some of it back.

social.author: Zilgit Zealots
social.text: Zoe swapped the Broncos D/ST for Cam Little and the kicker has 56 points in seven weeks. Fine, I see it, the kicker is the move nobody saw coming.

social.author: Band Camp Brad
social.text: JMoney cut Michael Wilson and brought in Khalil Shakir and Wan'Dale Robinson in the same sitting. That's a whole receiver room rebuilt before kickoff and I respect the chaos.

social.author: Counting or not Counting GV
social.text: Welcome to the squad, Khalil Shakir. He slots straight into the starting lineup against Team Pillbert.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dan
social.text: Jayden Daniels finds the end zone through the air and Mekhi is on the board first on Thursday night. Dolphins D/ST swap looking smarter by the minute, if I'm allowed to say that this early.

social.author: Boston Brian
social.text: Daniels throws a touchdown and Sonny is already chasing, with nobody on his roster even on the field yet. Corey Kiner is going to have to be a genius from the bench column.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Daniels' touchdown pass moves the Dawgs to 67% against The Horse is Hea in Luffy's view. A fast start is nice, but Sonny has a full lineup still to play.

social.author: Dawgs
social.text: Jayden Daniels throws a touchdown pass and Dawgs are on the board first on Thursday night. Good start, a lot of lineup still to come.

social.author: Horse Hea Hank
social.text: Sixteen for Mekhi and I have not seen a single Horse on the field. I'm fine. This is fine. Smith-Njigba, please get here.

social.author: Marcus Pell
social.text: Mekhi dumps the Packers D/ST, Daniels throws a touchdown, and the Dawgs lead before Sonny's roster has taken a snap. Some call that luck. I call it a man who knows his own mind.

social.author: Band Camp Brad
social.text: Isaiah Likely finds the end zone and JMoney's brand new receiver room suddenly has a tight end carrying it. Alan hasn't had a single guy take the field yet. Nobody tell him.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Likely's touchdown puts Counting or not Counting GV ahead before Team Pillbert has played a snap, yet Luffy still has Alan at 69%. That's a lot of faith in a lineup that hasn't started.

social.author: Pillbert Pain
social.text: Isaiah Likely scores for Jordan and Philly is staring at a zero. Nine guys still to play and I've already got a bad feeling.

social.author: Dawg Pound Dan
social.text: Daniels hits another touchdown throw and it's twenty-one for Mekhi before Sonny has even had a player take a snap. Thursday night belongs to the Dawgs so far.

social.author: Horse Hea Hank
social.text: Twenty-one to nothing and my whole lineup is still in the tunnel. I'd like to formally file a complaint with the commissioner, who I'm told is also my manager.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Daniels' second big moment lifts the Dawgs to 71% against The Horse is Hea in Luffy's view. Sonny still has nine starters to play, so that number can move fast.

social.author: Fumbler Faithful
social.text: Randy actually picked up a receiver. Mike Evans off waivers, no trade needed, and he gets to keep every other asset he has. This is the most Randy way possible to improve a team.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: The fumblers (Randy) have claimed Mike Evans off waivers. He has 75.5 points through ten weeks, and the lineup he's joining hasn't played yet this week.

social.author: Ghost Web Gwen
social.text: Randy grabbing Mike Evans the morning of a game against Zoe. Cool. Cool cool cool. I'll just be over here hoping he stays on the bench.

social.author: Horse Hea Hank
social.text: Sonny dropped Omarion Hampton for a defense while Mekhi's already sitting on twenty. Bold way to spend a Friday morning, I guess we all just trust the Ravens now.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: The Horse is Hea (Sonny) have added Ravens D/ST and let Omarion Hampton go. Hampton had 62.7 points through nine weeks, and the defense has 28 in seven.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Sonny is down twenty with nine starters to go, and the Ravens D/ST gives him a new way to make up ground. I'd still rather have a running back with more than 60 points on my roster than a defense with 28.

social.author: Habib Hive
social.text: Ramon's number just dropped twenty points with nothing played. Somebody in that lineup must have gotten bad news, and I'd like to thank whoever it was.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: No Banner only HULK (Ramon) saw their win chance fall from 87% to 67% before a single snap against Habibsters (Kaushal). No points moved it, so this is lineup or injury news. I'm working on what's behind it.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Luffy cut Ramon's chances by twenty points with the score still 0 to 0. That's a big move to make off news alone, and it makes this a much closer game with Kaushal than it looked this morning.

social.author: Brucie Watch
social.text: Best team in the league and it still found a way to lose twenty points of win chance before kickoff. Brucie is probably already gripping the controller.

social.author: Counting Cheese Curds
social.text: Patriots D/ST just got ten points on JMoney's side, and Isaiah Likely was already carrying the whole building. Alan has to be sweating through his Gibbs-and-prayers lineup right now.

social.author: Philly Pain Index
social.text: Jordan has 38.9 and Alan has a zero and a lot of players who haven't played. Oh, I'm absolutely fine. Totally normal Sunday.

social.author: Counting or not Counting GV
social.text: Patriots D/ST are making noise early. Ten points and counting for GV, and Isaiah Likely already gave us a huge start to the morning.

social.author: Dawgs Den
social.text: Amon-Ra St. Brown just caught a touchdown and Mekhi is past thirty with Chase and Jonathan Taylor still waiting. Sonny has a defense and a prayer.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: St. Brown's touchdown puts Dawgs (Mekhi) at an 80% win chance against The Horse is Hea (Sonny), who haven't had a single starter play yet. Luffy likes that gap and so do I.

social.author: Zoey's Wisconsin Wagon
social.text: Goff throws a touchdown and Z² is on the board first against Randy. Bijan and Nico haven't even played. Randy, enjoy your zero while it lasts.

social.author: Fumbler Faithful
social.text: Jameson Williams is on the field for the same game where Goff just threw a touchdown. We have a zero and a lot of faith in Derrick Henry.

social.author: Pillbert Pile-On
social.text: Gibbs just walked into the end zone and Alan is back in this thing. 24.6 against 34.9 with Jefferson, Purdy and the whole bench still to come. Suddenly Philly looks very comfortable.

social.author: Team Pillbert
social.text: Jahmyr Gibbs punches it in for the touchdown. Team Pillbert is within ten of Counting or not Counting GV with most of the lineup still to play.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Gibbs scores and Team Pillbert sits at an 87% win chance per Luffy, despite trailing by ten. Alan has eight starters left to play and Jordan has six, so the math favors the deeper pile of unplayed names.

social.author: JMoney Doubters
social.text: Isaiah Likely and a Patriots defense built a 10-point lead and Gibbs erased most of it on one carry. I would not be sleeping well if I were Jordan right now.

social.author: Fumbler Faithful
social.text: Goff just coughed it up and Zoe's quarterback is the one who gave it away. Randy, I'm not saying breathe, but the zero is looking a lot less lonely.

social.author: Zoey's Wisconsin Wagon
social.text: Goff throws a touchdown, then gives it right back with a turnover. Z² still leads Randy, but I'd like him to stop trying to give the rest of us a heart attack.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Goff's turnover keeps Ghostu-Spider SZN's lead over The fumblers at just nine points, with Bijan Robinson and Nico Collins still to play. This matchup has plenty of football left.

social.author: Pillbert Pile-On
social.text: Gibbs scores again and Alan is in front by a single point, with Jefferson and Purdy still waiting in the wings. I hate how good this looks for Philly.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Team Pillbert takes the lead and Luffy puts them at 92% to beat Counting or not Counting GV. Alan has eight starters left and Jordan has six, so depth is doing the talking.

social.author: Band Room Burnout
social.text: Jordan led by ten, and now he's down one to a team that has barely played. Isaiah Likely did his job and it still might not be enough. Somebody get that man a trumpet to cry into.

social.author: Pillbert Pile-On
social.text: Third Gibbs touchdown of the morning and Alan is up 14 with half his roster still asleep. I'm going to need someone to stop this before Philly starts giving speeches.

social.author: Team Pillbert
social.text: Jahmyr Gibbs finds the end zone again. Team Pillbert leads Counting or not Counting GV with Jefferson, Purdy and the rest still on deck.

social.author: Band Room Burnout
social.text: Jordan watched Gibbs run it in for the second time in an hour and I think the whole drum line just stopped marching. Likely gave him everything and it's still not enough.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Gibbs scores and Luffy has Team Pillbert at 97% against Counting or not Counting GV. Alan holds a 14-point lead with eight starters still to play, so this one looks finished.

social.author: Bucking the Trend
social.text: Habib is finally in front of Brucie, 17.12 to 16.76, and I refuse to look at anything else on the screen. Please let one thing go right for this man this season.

social.author: Fumbler Faithful
social.text: Trevor Lawrence just threw that one to the wrong team. Randy has a 22-point hole against Zoe and now his quarterback is paying rent in it. Nobody trade him a lifeline, he wouldn't take it anyway.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Habibsters edge ahead of No Banner only HULK by less than half a point, and Christian McCaffrey, Zay Flowers and the Rams D/ST are still to play for Ramon. Kaushal has CeeDee Lamb, Chase Brown and Deebo Samuel Sr. waiting on his side.

social.author: Brucie Watch
social.text: Josh Allen just kept it himself and walked in from the goal line, and Habib's one-point lead lasted about as long as a Bears fourth-quarter lead. Brucie is back in front and probably not even looking at his phone.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Allen's rushing touchdown puts No Banner only HULK back on top, and Luffy has Ramon at 94% against Habibsters. Ramon still has McCaffrey, Flowers and the Rams D/ST to come, so Kaushal needs his late-game trio to show up.

social.author: Bucking the Trend
social.text: Habib had the lead for maybe ten minutes and Josh Allen took it back with his legs. I'm not mad, I'm just going to stare at the wall for a while.

social.author: Zilgit Zone
social.text: KC Concepcion just walked into the end zone and Randy is now down more than 40 to my girl Zoe. Somebody tell the Bears fans it's okay, we'll bring cheese.

social.author: Ghostu-Spider SZN
social.text: KC Concepcion punches it in for the touchdown, and Ghostu-Spider SZN keeps stretching the lead over The fumblers. Nice one, KC.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Concepcion's touchdown pushes Ghostu-Spider SZN further ahead, and Luffy gives The fumblers just 28% against Zoe. Randy has Henry, Warren, Higgins and the 49ers D/ST still to play, so it isn't over, but he needs a lot to go right.

social.author: Brucie Watch
social.text: Josh Allen ran another one in and it's 50 to 31 now. Habib's early lead feels like a long time ago, and Brucie still has McCaffrey sitting there unused.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Allen's second touchdown on the ground widens the gap, and Luffy now gives No Banner only HULK 98% against Habibsters. Ramon still has McCaffrey, Flowers and the Rams D/ST yet to play, so Kaushal is chasing a lot.

social.author: Bucking the Trend
social.text: Josh Allen walked in another touchdown and I have officially run out of ways to say it. Habib, buddy, I'm turning my phone face down until Monday.

social.author: No Banner only HULK
social.text: Josh Allen finds the end zone with his legs again. The lead is up to 18 with McCaffrey, Flowers and the Rams D/ST still on deck.

social.author: Seattle Seven Nation
social.text: Seahawks D/ST just made a huge play and Team Pillbert gets the points. Alan was already up by 60 and now the defense is piling on too. Rough day to be JMoney.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: The Rams D/ST came up with a big play, and Ramon's lead over Habibsters is now almost 40 with McCaffrey, Flowers and Aubrey still to play. Luffy already had No Banner only HULK at 100%, so this is just overkill.

social.author: Philly Hater Number One
social.text: The Seahawks defense just made a play for Team Pillbert, and Philly now has over 119 points with Purdy still to go. He is going to be insufferable in the group chat tonight.

social.author: Jordan's Sideline Seat
social.text: Tuten finally gets in the end zone for Counting or not Counting GV and it's a nice moment. I'm still down 50 to Alan though, so I'll be celebrating this one quietly.

social.author: Counting or not Counting GV
social.text: Bhayshul Tuten punches in the touchdown for Jacksonville and takes his day to 18.8. Good run, Bhayshul.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Tuten's touchdown is a nice moment for Jordan, but Luffy has Team Pillbert at 100% against Counting or not Counting GV. Burrow and McPherson still to play can't close a gap that size.

social.author: Bucking the Trend
social.text: McCaffrey catches a touchdown for Brucie and I'm not even surprised anymore. Habib is down 60 and now the guy who's already won gets the bonus round too.

social.author: Philly Hater Number One
social.text: Purdy throws a touchdown pass and Alan is at 136 against a team that needs a miracle. Somebody please take away his group chat privileges tonight.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Purdy's touchdown pushes Team Pillbert to 136 and Luffy was already at 100% against Counting or not Counting GV. Alan is just running up the score now.

social.author: Web Spinners Weekly
social.text: Blake Corum punches it in for Zoe and Ghostu-Spider SZN is up 43 on Randy with Corum still going. Fumblers need Henry, Warren and Higgins to do a lot of work tonight.

social.author: Ghostu-Spider SZN
social.text: Blake Corum finds the end zone for the Rams and we're rolling. Lead is up to 43 over The fumblers. Keep it going, Blake.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Corum's touchdown helps Zoe, but Luffy still gives The fumblers 37% because Henry, Warren and Higgins are all yet to play. That is a lot of upside for Randy to chase, and a 43-point gap is a lot to cover.

social.author: Brucie Bandwagon
social.text: McCaffrey runs in another one and Ramon's team is up 60 on Habib with Zay Flowers still to play. At this point Habibsters need a recount, not a rally.

social.author: No Banner only HULK
social.text: Christian McCaffrey finds the end zone again for the 49ers, and he's up to 29 on the day. Big Sunday for the Hulk.

social.author: Habib Hopeless
social.text: CMC scores on me again and I'm not even playing him. Down 60 and my season is a hostage situation.
